Next comes your first meal plan. Favourite foods, cuisines and foods to avoid are further down this page and can wait.

Per-profile lists that bias and constrain meal-plan generation. Avoid entries are skipped entirely; favourites and the cuisines you like are softly preferred, and what you would rather not eat is planned only where nothing else fits. Allergens are always honoured — across generation, swaps and substitutions.
